note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry; each one names the sources its facts come from. Where a step is not pinned down by a source, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing specifics.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no extra task of its own. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, with the 100% completion gold the longest single job. No online play and no DLC is needed; everything is single-player and offline.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 1; PowerPyx notes it pops as the story rolls into Chapter 2, on completing that chapter's first main mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as the story opens Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; PowerPyx notes it pops early in Chapter 4, after the first two main missions there.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4 — it pops on completing the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the final mission of the game — PowerPyx ties it to Chapter 4's Starting From Zero. There is free-roam after the story, but no mission replay, so keep a save at the start of each chapter.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and of the required collectibles you typically need only 70-80% — for example any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything is doable in free-roam after the story. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps, and you can mix categories — Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. View them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most unlock naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a dedicated page for all 12 locations and 42 gold medals; the medals are not very difficult, and the ranges are required in full for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx). Drone races are required in full for the 100% checklist, so this comes along the way.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so you can pick the 20 that suit you best.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento — do that quest to unlock it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game ('Video Game' in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one of them counts — you do not need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her Belville address. Five quests in total: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline opens in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; he marks treasure-diving shipwrecks (purple chest icons) and wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total — use the metal detector on the ocean floor. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason speeds it up), so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline marks automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them, and notes Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Track your count in the trophy list; all strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His 'Randy's Wish List' questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered; track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether he wants one. Deliver in good condition for more money. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason-only: after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy enough of them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. THE LIST'S ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY (PowerPyx): the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is gone for good after Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that one is actually required (it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot), so do it to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break he texts you and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' in the first quest; his quests ask you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him. All 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations in total — you need any 3 complete sets. KeenGamer notes the 100% checklist needs 15 complete sets, so keep collecting past 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up + R1 to scan things in the world — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are well over 100, so any 100 will do. The 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK locations too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total, so pick the easiest 50; the 100% checklist needs any 70, so this pops on the way. Track them under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Needs both characters free-roaming together, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with right + triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape: PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, and it also comes automatically while robbing the large bank vaults for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner and hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while staying chased the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, and if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. PowerPyx's suggested spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3). The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan — scanning counts, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this pops early. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first (food, drinks, a shower at home, Adrenaline to extend it), wear body armor, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 gang criminals at a Gang Operation; PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — it grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, as planes parked on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx's easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away from the airport before it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino). They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it trips the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. PowerPyx's suggested store is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip for van locations (after his Payday Loan jobs). Vaults instantly give 4 stars — escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck — and all 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, sticky-bomb its back door, then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map (PSN tracks 52 areas). Fastest by plane: fly over every fogged patch until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx has a dedicated unfogging guide with the best plane.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them; track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window — only that specific car counts. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS first. The pop is slightly delayed; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a Gang Operation. You go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table) and the safe (north-east hallway — sticky bombs open it). The trophy pops after you escape the police. Not missable: the robbery icon respawns, so you can return for anything you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Needs character switching, unlocked after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Work out at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities for them), always with both characters together — while one trains, the other finishes their training automatically, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile (PSN tracks the count). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see each one register. It grows passively through robberies and encounters while you work on everything else — PowerPyx says not to worry about it. If it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but pushing the profile to Psycho or Irredeemable makes cops shoot on sight, and Irredeemable is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Currently unknown. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet solved and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. No confirmed method yet; this guide will not invent one. Check PowerPyx's guide for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and return if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods to the UFO's blue light, approach it, and it drops the woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across robberies; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each. It comes naturally while doing the 100% robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive things in the game. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores and more.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (there are 4 more story garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
